name: THE HOSPITAL
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461, 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428 (roofs and cover), 441; ask row 468's list, the twelfth: 'THE HOSPITAL: smaller, still house-tiled.'
facts: A big hospital's emergency department is treatment bays along its walls, each a bed behind a curtain, round a central nurses' station, with the ambulance bay's doors at one end and the waiting room at the other; a ward is beds in rows.
On house tiles a bay is smaller than a tile, so a tile of bays is a run of them, its partitions the walls between.

In a collapse a hospital is emptied of what can be carried first: the drugs, then the oxygen, then the beds. The pharmacy's cage is the last thing anybody fights over and the first thing anybody opened.
The valley's medical district is the hospital and its labs; the labs' pens out the back are the lab's own board (the place), never this one.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (hospital_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The medical district is the hospital: the parking garage takes its own share there first (garage.json); of the rest, seven in ten are fought inside, by the cell's own dice.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The hospital's wall: no way through.

partition.effect: A partition between two runs of bays: no way through.

floor.effect: The corridor's floor: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

bay.effect: A run of treatment bays, the curtains torn down, a bed and its dead machines in each: low cover.

beds.effect: A ward's beds in their row, the mattresses gone: low cover.

gurney.effect: Gurneys pushed together, one on its side: low cover.

carts.effect: Crash carts and IV poles, the drawers pulled out and empty: low cover.

chairs.effect: The waiting room's chairs in their rows: low cover, and slow going over them (3 AP). [bb] its brush.
chairs.say: Waiting room chairs: low cover, slow going.

station.effect: The nurses' station, its counter chest high: cover.

pharmacy.effect: The pharmacy's cage, cut open and emptied long ago: nobody stands on its tile; cover for the tiles beside it. [bb] its boulder.

slick.effect: The floor slick with what was spilled and never cleaned: open ground and slow going (3 AP a step). [bb] its swamp.
slick.say: Slick floor: slow going, open ground.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a steel bin. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The ambulance bay's doors, jammed open: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The ambulance doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in hospital_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: a ground floor. The bays and the station are the board.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the dropped ceiling's grid, tiles out where the wiring hangs, the light panels dead, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in.
